name: SlideASR-Bench
description: SlideASR-Bench is an audio benchmark for automatic speech recognition focused on slide-based presentations and related spoken content. It measures transcription accuracy on audio typical to slide talks (e.g., short utterances, speaker variability, background noise) and is intended to test ASR robustness in presentation/lecture settings. The dataset pairs audio clips with reference transcripts for evaluation.
reputation: A specialized, relatively new benchmark for presentation/slide ASR with limited adoption outside targeted ASR research.
